QuestInfo.name: OSSS Mission Issued
QuestInfo.0: OSSS is ready to issue a mission. Talk to #b#p9250133##k when you're ready.
QuestInfo.1: Use the Orders given to you by #b#p9250133##k and complete each of the OSSS missions. When you complete the missions, you'll be given #b#t04310004#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: You've completed all of the OSSS missions. If you want to be issued these missions again, talk to #b#p9250133##k.

0.0: Well, now. Here you are. To defeat the aliens, you must complete missions issued by the OSSS.
0.1: The OSSS has promised to reward you for your efforts. Remember that #byou can only repeat this mission 3 times a day#k.
0.2: In order to complete each mission, you must have with you these four Orders. Please hold on to them to complete your missions.

yes.0: Okay, the Orders have been given to you. Please accept each mission separately by talking to me again.
yes.1: When you've successfully completed a mission, the OSSS will issue you a #b#t04310004##k. Once you've collected a bunch, talk to #b#p9250135##k, who will give you cells that will make your suit stronger.
yes.2: Each time you complete a mission, you'll get a completion certificate. Please hold on to them and submit them all at once during the final verification process. Four orders. Four certificates. Should be easy to remember.

no.0: You waiting for the aliens to attack before you do something to stop them? Bad idea...

1.0: Have you completed all the missions?

yes.0: Good job. Now, you'll be able to receive each of the missions again. Start by completing the OSSS Mission Order mission.

default.0: Let's talk again once you've completed each of the individual missions.
